results.rubric_item: Explain a key network effect involving Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) who develop services on the largest cloud platforms to maximize their audience, which in turn attracts more users to these platforms.

The concentration of ISV activity on the largest platforms creates a moat against competing providers.

This developer experience advantage creates a self-reinforcing cycle where popular platforms attract more developers, which in turn attracts more customers seeking to hire developers familiar with those platforms.
